svg.title: Binary search convergence for lower_bound
svg.desc: Finding the leftmost index whose value is not less than the target, 2, in the array 1, 2, 2, 2, 4, 7. The search keeps narrowing toward the left whenever the middle value is already at or above the target.
svg.text: low = 0, high = 6, mid = 3 → value 2 is not less than target, search left half
low = 0, high = 3, mid = 1 → value 2 is not less than target, search left half
low = 0, high = 1, mid = 0 → value 1 is less than target, search right half
low = high = 1 → lower_bound = 1, the first index with a value ≥ target
